artifact_diffs: Created 27 source-anchored language units across eight available chapter classes, led by 12 Summary and 9 Introduction units.

Added independent P12 evidence to LP-A-ABS-TASK-METHOD-RESULT, LP-A-ABS-BOUNDARY, and LP-A-INT-METHOD-ROADMAP; revised LP-A-ABS-PARAGRAPH-CHAIN to cover bounded scientific meaning and promoted it from candidate to corroborated after its third independent paper.
Explicitly excluded P12 from LP-A-ABS-MODEL-STAIRCASE because vector-tree geometry and sunlight irradiance are complementary models rather than baseline and extension.

Added two positive language entries and four negative language diagnostics for held-fixed comparisons, dependency chains, accurate-enough claims, unnamed real-life data, unbounded maximization, and informal adequacy.
Created a source-checked paper card and 32 atomic observations with 10 language observations and only one weakness observation.
Created 6 formula-level model units containing 25 visually checked equations and an explicit unresolved leaf-placement/irradiance feedback loop.
Appended evidence to 10 existing A rules without changing their lifecycle states.
Recorded complete visual review for all 29 pages and full-resolution equation review for pages 8-19.

validation_results.details: 32 observations, 41 A rules, and 29 visually reviewed pages.
27 source-anchored language units across eight available chapter classes.
Four recurring patterns use independent content identities; P12 was not counted as model-staircase evidence.
6 models and 25 core equations passed variable, dependency, and visual-check validation.
All 29 rendered pages passed image and complete visual-review checks.

unresolved_added: The rounding operation in N=[theta sigma(k)] is undefined.
The functional forms, domains, and calibration data for d(I) and p(I) are absent.
The leaf-placement and irradiance feedback loop has no documented solution order or convergence rule.
The sunlight model uses phi inconsistently and prints an angular weight that can be negative over its stated domain.
The printed net-photosynthesis root does not solve the preceding quadratic.
The environmental factor, venation traits, stomatal traits, and physiological parameters used for LMA are not reported.
The weighted-average LMA rule is not defined.
The case-tree LAI is transferred from literature rather than measured for the individual tree.
The case study changes LMA from 177.74 to 177.47 g/m^2 in the final multiplication.
No observed total leaf mass validates the 12777.84 g prediction.
The usefulArea code counts projected branch points rather than explicit leaf-shadow polygons.
